description: This file defines the LoanCollateralManagementRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor to provide data access methods for LoanCollateralManagement entities, including a custom query to find collateral management records by related loan.

classes.name: LoanCollateralManagementRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing LoanCollateralManagement entities with Spring Data JPA, including a custom method for finding collaterals by loan.

methods.name: findByLoan
methods.description: Custom query method to retrieve a list of LoanCollateralManagement entities associated with a specific Loan object.
